notes: Sources: one usable file, 2018_01 (HR benefits overview page). Apart from a short HR benefits overview, it is site navigation, contact details and footer.
Document date: no version date; footer '© 2018'; Wayback capture 2018-03-07, within the 2017-18 reference year, so accepted as in force on 2018-03-13.

The page is an HR summary listing benefits; it names no parental, maternity, adoption or FMLA provision and gives no lengths or pay levels. The governing documents (benefit plan documents, which the page says are 'available in the Human Resources Department'; any faculty handbook leave policy, not named on the page) are not saved. All five components therefore rest on a summary page only; I did not flag summary_only because no governing document is saved against which to test the absence, and flagged each with an ambiguous rule-gap note instead.

Not components: holidays (fixed dates, cannot be taken for a birth); medical, dental and life insurance, 403(b), FSA, tuition benefits and the employee assistance program (no time off, pay or protection for a new parent).
Statutes: none named in the document. FMLA and the Connecticut FMLA are not mentioned; the statutory floor (FMLA, U7) is filled from statutory_baseline.csv.

Chain, birth parent: no parental or childbirth leave stated; own sick days (c3) and short-term disability insurance (c1, no stated length) are unlinked pay sources; long-term disability (c2) recorded without length; vacation (c4) and personal days (c5) are general-purpose. No sequence links.
Chain, non-birth parent: no leave or benefit specific to a birth stated; only general-purpose vacation (c4) and personal days (c5). No sequence links.
